notes.tarkington: OSM 'Tarkington (Newton Booth) Residence Hall (TARK)' (relation/12647702); the code in its OSM name kept the name rules from matching.
notes.honors-college: OSM 'Honors College and Residences North' (way/470285119, housenumber 1101), the school's address 1101 Third Street; South (HCRS) is its twin across the courtyard.
notes.hilltop: Purdue's buildings layer (https://services1.arcgis.com/mLNdQKiKsj5Z5YMN/arcgis/rest/services/Purdue_Buildings/FeatureServer/0) has 'Hilltop Apartment 23' at 23 Hilltop Drive, the school's address (23-5 Hilltop Drive); the pin is its centre. OSM has no named Hilltop building.
notes.BRNG: OSM 'Beering Hall (BRNG)' carries the code in its name; the map list calls it Beering (Steven C.) Hall of Liberal Arts and Education.
notes.LWSN: OSM 'Lawson Hall (LWSN)'; the map list calls it Lawson (Richard and Patricia) Computer Science Building.
notes.PRCE: OSM 'Pierce Hall (PRCE)' is the list's Peirce Hall.
notes.CONV: OSM 'Convergence Center for Innovation and Collaboration (CONV)'; the list says Convergence.
notes.BRES: OSM 'Drew and Brittany Brees Student-Athletic Academic Center (BRES)'.
notes.LILY: OSM 'Lilly Hall' is the list's Lilly Hall of Life Sciences.
notes.WSLR: OSM 'Whistler Hall' is the list's Whistler (Roy L.) Hall of Agricultural Research.
notes.MRRT: OSM 'Marriot Hall' (sic) is the list's Marriott Hall.
notes.HANS: OSM 'Hansen Hall' is the list's Hansen (Arthur G.) Life Sciences Research Building.
notes.the-pete-dye-clubhouse: Golf clubhouse at the Birck Boilermaker Golf Complex, not a class or meal place.
notes.south-hall: South Hall opens fall 2026; OSM maps its site as landuse=construction 'South Hall' at 300 McCutcheon Drive (way/1315532367, no building yet), and the pin is that site's middle. The word rule had picked Honors College and Residences South.

detours.why: Convergence's only mapped way in is its service drive from the south; no mapped path leads to it from State Street on its north side, so walks from the halls across State Street go round by the road to its east.
The fire station's yard lies between Shreve and the band complex with no mapped path across, so walks go round by the road on its east side.
